properties.displayName: UAV S16 - ESC Firmware Tampering (Persistent Motor Compromise)
properties.description: UAVFirmware_CL에서 ESC 컴포넌트로의 flash_write 이벤트 중 FirmwareHash가 Watchlist(Approved_Firmware_Hash_List)에 없거나 Signed=false인 경우 탐지. 공격자가 서명 미검증/비인가 해시의 변조 펌웨어를 ESC에 플래시해 모터 제어를 재부팅 후에도 지속 장악(persistence)하려는 시도. MITRE Enterprise ATT&CK: T1495 Firmware Corruption / MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0879
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 1h;
let ApprovedHashes = _GetWatchlist('Approved_Firmware_Hash_List') | project Hash;
UAVFirmware_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where FlashEventType == 'flash_write'
| where ComponentId startswith 'ESC'
| extend isUnapprovedHash = FirmwareHash !in (ApprovedHashes)
| extend isUnsigned = Signed == false
| where isUnapprovedHash or isUnsigned
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isUnsigned, strcat('ESC_미서명_펌웨어_플래시_', ComponentId),
    strcat('ESC_비인가_해시_펌웨어_플래시_', ComponentId))
| extend Severity = 'High'
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, ComponentId, FirmwareHash, Signed, FlashEventType, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S16 - ESC Firmware Tampering (Persistent Motor Compromise) - {{UAVId}}
